$comment: Examples for the server globals the API explorer builds from the tables of server-api.md and voice.md (they have no card in wiki/data/api.json). Keyed by qualified name; merged by src/lib/server-api-docs.ts. Written for a server owner: a command, a handler or a thread, never a bare signature.
exports:
-- Publish a bank service other server resources can call
local balances = {}
exports("balance", function(playerId)
    return balances[Open77.players.identifier(playerId)] or 0
end)

-- From another resource: synchronous proxy, or the asynchronous form
local money = exports.bank:balance(source)
FadePlayerScreen:
-- Bracket a teleport with a fade: black, move, back
CreateThread(function()
    FadePlayerScreen(playerId, true, 400)
    Wait(400)
    Open77.players.teleport(playerId, { x = -1442.2, y = 127.4, z = 18.0 }, { fade = false })
    FadePlayerScreen(playerId, false, 400)
end)
GetCurrentResourceGeneration:
-- Ignore a timer that fires after this resource was reloaded
local generation = GetCurrentResourceGeneration()
SetTimeout(60000, function()
    if GetCurrentResourceGeneration() ~= generation then return end
    save()
end)
GetCurrentResourceName:
-- Prefix log lines and kvp keys with the resource name
print(("[%s] started"):format(GetCurrentResourceName()))
GetInvokingResource:
-- A service export trusts the caller's real name, never an argument
exports("registerJob", function(definition)
    local owner = GetInvokingResource()
    jobs[owner] = definition
    return true
end)
GetInvokingResourceGeneration:
-- Retire handles a reloaded caller left behind
exports("open", function()
    local owner, generation = GetInvokingResource(), GetInvokingResourceGeneration()
    if generations[owner] ~= generation then
        closeAll(owner)
        generations[owner] = generation
    end
    return newHandle(owner)
end)
GetPlayerIdentity:
-- /whois <id>: the account behind a session
RegisterCommand("whois", function(source, args)
    local identity = GetPlayerIdentity(tonumber(args[1]))
    if not identity then return Open77.chat.send(source, "No such player.") end
    Open77.chat.send(source, ("%s, account %s"):format(identity.name, identity.userId))
end, true)
GetPlayers:
-- Announce a restart to everyone currently connected
RegisterCommand("announce", function(source, args)
    local text = table.concat(args, " ")
    for _, playerId in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
        Open77.chat.send(playerId, text)
    end
end, true)
GetPlayersInBucket:
-- Start the race only when the lobby instance has at least two players
local racers = GetPlayersInBucket(RACE_BUCKET)
if #racers >= 2 then
    startRace(racers)
end
GetPlayerSpectateTarget:
-- A spectator cannot be damaged by what they are watching
if GetPlayerSpectateTarget(playerId) ~= 0 then return end
GetPlayerSpectators:
-- Tell a streamer how many admins are watching them
local count = #GetPlayerSpectators(playerId)
if count > 0 then
    Open77.chat.send(playerId, ("%d admin(s) are spectating you."):format(count))
end
GetPlayersPositions:
-- Count who is inside the event zone, in one pass
local inside = 0
for playerId, pos in pairs(GetPlayersPositions()) do
    if #(vector3(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z) - zoneCenter) < zoneRadius then
        inside = inside + 1
    end
end
GetPlayerStats:
-- /stats: both pools in one read
RegisterCommand("stats", function(source)
    local stats = GetPlayerStats(source)
    if stats then
        Open77.chat.send(source, ("HP %d / %d, stamina %d / %d"):format(
            stats.health, stats.maxHealth, stats.stamina, stats.maxStamina))
    end
end, false)
GetResourceState:
-- Wait for a dependency to be running before using its export
CreateThread(function()
    while GetResourceState("bank") ~= "running" do Wait(500) end
    print("bank is up")
end)
GetScreenEffectCatalog:
-- Validate an item's screen effect at startup
local known = {}
for _, alias in ipairs(GetScreenEffectCatalog()) do known[alias] = true end
assert(known["drunk"], "this server does not support the drunk effect")
GetUnixTime:
-- A ban that expires in 24 hours (the sandbox has no os.time)
bans[userId] = { expiresAt = GetUnixTime() + 86400 }
GetUtcTimestamp:
-- Timestamp an audit line
print(GetUtcTimestamp(), "player", source, "bought", itemId)
IsPlayerFrozen:
-- Refuse a second /cuff on a player somebody already holds
if IsPlayerFrozen(target) then
    return Open77.chat.send(source, "They are already restrained.")
end
IsPlayerGhosted:
-- Spawn protection is still on: skip the damage report
if IsPlayerGhosted(victimId) then return end
IsPlayerVisible:
-- A hidden admin is skipped by the scoreboard
for _, playerId in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
    if IsPlayerVisible(playerId) then
        table.insert(board, Open77.players.name(playerId))
    end
end
playerConnecting:
-- A FiveM-style whitelist runs unchanged; refuse with deferrals.done(message)
AddEventHandler("playerConnecting", function(name, setKickReason, deferrals)
    deferrals.defer()
    deferrals.update("Checking the whitelist...")
    if not whitelisted[name] then
        return deferrals.done("You are not on the whitelist.")
    end
    deferrals.done()
end)
playerDropped:
-- Save the player's money when they leave; source is the player who left
AddEventHandler("playerDropped", function(reason)
    local key = "money:" .. (Open77.players.identifier(source) or "")
    Open77.kvp.set(key, wallet[source] or 0)
    wallet[source] = nil
end)
playerJoining:
-- FiveM's join event: source is the new player id, oldId is always empty here
AddEventHandler("playerJoining", function(oldId)
    print("player", source, "was assigned a session")
end)
PlayerScreenEffect:
-- Drinking makes the screen wobble for 30 seconds
RegisterNetEvent("items:drink", function()
    PlayerScreenEffect(source, "drunk", { strength = 0.5, duration = 30 })
end)
print:
-- Goes to the server log, prefixed with the resource name
print(("player %d bought %s"):format(source, itemId))
RestorePlayerHealth:
-- Round start: everyone at full health
for _, playerId in ipairs(GetPlayersInBucket(ARENA_BUCKET)) do
    RestorePlayerHealth(playerId)
end
RestorePlayerStamina:
-- An energy drink
RegisterNetEvent("items:energyDrink", function()
    RestorePlayerStamina(source)
end)
SetPlayerFrozen:
-- /freeze <id> toggles a hold on a player
RegisterCommand("freeze", function(source, args)
    local target = tonumber(args[1])
    if not target then return end
    SetPlayerFrozen(target, not IsPlayerFrozen(target))
end, true)
SetPlayerGhosted:
-- Spawn protection: non-solid for 10 seconds or until they walk 15 m away
AddEventHandler("onPlayerReady", function(playerId)
    SetPlayerGhosted(playerId, true, { clearMs = 10000, clearDistance = 15.0 })
end)
SetPlayerHealth:
-- /sethp <id> <value>
RegisterCommand("sethp", function(source, args)
    local target, value = tonumber(args[1]), tonumber(args[2])
    if target and value then SetPlayerHealth(target, value) end
end, true)
SetPlayerMaxHealth:
-- A perk raises the maximum health to 150
SetPlayerMaxHealth(playerId, 150)
SetPlayerMaxStamina:
-- A "runner" job class gets a bigger stamina pool
SetPlayerMaxStamina(playerId, 150)
SetPlayerRegen:
-- Hardcore server: health never comes back on its own
AddEventHandler("onPlayerReady", function(playerId)
    SetPlayerRegen(playerId, 0)
end)
SetPlayerRegenEnabled:
-- Bleeding: no regeneration until bandaged, the configured rate is remembered
SetPlayerRegenEnabled(playerId, false)
RegisterNetEvent("items:bandage", function()
    SetPlayerRegenEnabled(source, true)
end)
SetPlayerStamina:
-- The player just ran a marathon: stamina to 10
SetPlayerStamina(playerId, 10)
SetPlayerStaminaRegen:
-- Athletic perk: stamina regenerates twice as fast
SetPlayerStaminaRegen(playerId, 20)
SetPlayerStaminaRegenEnabled:
-- Exhaustion: no stamina regeneration for 20 seconds
SetPlayerStaminaRegenEnabled(playerId, false)
SetTimeout(20000, function() SetPlayerStaminaRegenEnabled(playerId, true) end)
SetPlayerVisible:
-- /vanish toggles an invisible admin
RegisterCommand("vanish", function(source)
    hidden[source] = not hidden[source]
    SetPlayerVisible(source, not hidden[source])
end, true)
SpectatePlayer:
-- /spectate <id>, and /spectate alone to stop
RegisterCommand("spectate", function(source, args)
    local target = tonumber(args[1]) or false
    local ok, reason = SpectatePlayer(source, target, { distance = 5.0 })
    if not ok then Open77.chat.send(source, "Cannot spectate: " .. reason) end
end, true)
TriggerClientEvent:
-- Tell one player their deposit went through, and everyone about the restart
TriggerClientEvent("bank:deposit", playerId, 250)
TriggerClientEvent("server:announce", -1, "Restart in 5 minutes")
AdoptElevator:
-- AdoptElevator is the positional low-level form of Open77.elevators.adopt; resources are told to prefer
-- the Open77.* spelling, which is what the example shows.
-- Take over a vanilla lift so the server drives its floors
local id, reason = Open77.elevators.adopt({ anchor = { x = -1442.2, y = 127.4, z = 18.0 }, floors = 4 })
if not id then print("adopt refused: " .. tostring(reason)) end
